'''TBR-312''' was the designation of a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], he was stationed on [[Belazura]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], disguised as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]], tried to get into the back of a factory, TBR-312 and [[TBR-312's partner|his partner]] stopped him to ask for his access codes. When Skywalker refused to show them, TBR-312 informed the staff, whereupon Skywalker killed him with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
